title: Every Time I Sneeze, I Swap Places With a Stranger (preview)

scenes.note: Max at his desk… sneezes ("Every time I sneeze")
…and swap places with a random stranger: Max is suddenly on a busy street holding someone's shopping
…and the stranger (a grandma) lands at his school desk, totally confused
Today the pollen count was the highest in history: Max walking past blooming trees, itchy nose
…highest in history (big red RECORD pop)
"My name is Max." Max waves in front of his school
It started in the middle of a math test (the whole class writing, MATH TEST on the board)
ACHOO! (close on Max, the whole desk shakes)
Suddenly Max is in a pizza shop
…with dough flying over his head (he tries to catch it)
And the pizza chef? Poof: he is sitting at Max's desk
…staring at the math test (close, he scratches his head)
ACHOO! (the dough flops onto his head)
Now I was a goalkeeper (Max in the goal, arms up)
…in a giant stadium with fifty thousand people screaming (huge sweeping wide)
The ball flew straight at his face (ball rockets toward the goal)
…at my face (close: the ball fills the frame, Max cross-eyed)
"I sneezed again." ACHOO! just before impact
I was in the zoo (wide: LIONS sign, visitors behind the bars)
Inside the lion cage… (the lion is right behind him)
…holding a bucket of meat
The lion looked at me (slow push in on the lion's face)
I looked at the lion (Max, sweating)
The zookeeper was now in my math class
ACHOO! (the lion jumps back in fright)
A wedding! Everyone was staring at me (Max at the flower arch beside the bride, rows of guests staring)
…I was holding the ring (sparkle)
ACHOO! (petals blast everywhere)
A fire truck! (it roars down the street, lights flashing)
And I was driving it! (side close, Max gripping the wheel)
